scenes.headline: How a frontier model's index score is assembled
scenes.sub: Ten evaluations, four categories, one weighted average
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Quasar! Meta's new model scores two points behind the leader on a popular index. Let's see what those two points are made of.

scenes.text: A composite index is a weighted average. The size of a gap matters less than which benchmark it comes from.
scenes.say: A composite index is a weighted average. The size of a gap matters less than which benchmark it comes from.

scenes.title: From ten evaluations to one number

steps.say: Ten benchmarks sit in four groups: agents, coding, general knowledge and science.
Two agent tests are judged head to head, so their ratings are mapped onto a zero to one scale first.
Every score is multiplied by its weight and added up.
Rebuilt from the published scores, Wonder Full lands on exactly the number on the leaderboard.

scenes.title: One judged benchmark's share
scenes.say: Here is how a judged rating turns into points.

parts.say: Fifteen is this benchmark's share of the whole.

parts.note: the rating, squeezed onto zero to one
parts.say: The rating is squeezed onto zero to one, so about a hundred and thirty Elo buys one index point.

scenes.title: Where the gap to Opus 5.5 comes from
scenes.note: Index points per benchmark after weighting
scenes.say: One factual recall benchmark hands Opus more than the whole gap. The same benchmark pays Wonder back for declining to guess. Everything else is a few tenths.

scenes.label: Output tokens per task, Wonder Full against Opus 5.5
scenes.note: Measured by Artificial Analysis across the index
scenes.say: And it gets there on less than half the output tokens per task.

steps.note: Targeted tasks across, untargeted tasks up
steps.say: Meta's own test plots tasks it trained toward against tasks it did not. Wonder Full sits about ten points higher. The task sets are not named, so nobody can check it.

scenes.text: Read an index gap row by row: this one is factual recall, the hardest thing to game.
scenes.say: Read an index gap row by row. This one is mostly factual recall, which is the hardest thing to game.

recap: A weighted sum of ten benchmarks
scenes.say: A weighted sum of ten benchmarks. A gap that is mostly recall. And half the tokens per task.
